subject: Cognitive Science
title: The Representativeness Heuristic
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Representativeness Heuristic.

hook.text: Linda is outspoken and studied philosophy. Is she more likely a bank teller, or a feminist bank teller?

buildup.text: Most people pick feminist bank teller—but that's mathematically impossible. It's a subset of bank tellers.

discovery.text: The representativeness heuristic: we judge probability by how well something fits a stereotype.

twist.text: It ignores base rates entirely. The description "matches" a feminist, so logic gets overridden by resemblance.

climax.text: In medicine, a rare disease that fits symptoms perfectly gets diagnosed over common ones that don't.

punchline.text: Looking like the type doesn't make it the type.

quiz.question: What does the representativeness heuristic cause?
options: Judging probability by resemblance instead of base rates
